data.long_meaning: The name Nabili is derived from the Arabic word 'nabi' meaning prophet, and 'ili' meaning gift from God. This name signifies the blessing and gift of having a child, given by Allah. The name Nabili carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nabili usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
